page_title: WOL 2-3 AUG | Wolfsburg v Augsburg 21/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.

90+8' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) takes the resultant free kick from the edge of the box and tries to find one of his teammates with a cross, but the keeper climbs high and gets to it first, collecting the ball with ease.
90+8' Michael Gregoritsch (Augsburg) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
90+5' Daniel Bauer has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jonas Adjetey (Wolfsburg) replacing Denis Vavro.
90+5' Substitution. Jan Burger (Wolfsburg) has come on for Sael Kumbedi.
90+3' 2 - 3 Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) scores! He latches on to a pass and produces a perfect strike from the edge of the box. The ball goes into the bottom right corner and past the goalkeeper.
90+1' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
87' 2 - 2 Goal! Michael Gregoritsch (Augsburg) puts the ball into the bottom left corner past the outstretched arm of Kamil Grabara.
86' Kristijan Jakic (Augsburg) picked up a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. He has to be careful for the remainder of the match.
86' Jeanuel Belocian (Wolfsburg) is arguing with the referee and is given a caution.
86' Penalty! A huge opportunity to score for Augsburg.
85' The referee signals a corner kick to Augsburg.
83' Kento Shiogai (Wolfsburg) goes on a mazy run and neatly slips through the defence. However, he fails in the final task - beating the goalkeeper, as Finn Dahmen is alert enough to deny him.
82' Problems for Daniel Bauer as Mohamed Amoura is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Dzenan Pejcinovic (Wolfsburg) replaces him.
82' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
81' Here is a change. Robin Fellhauer is going off and Manuel Baum gives the last tactical orders to Uchenna Ogundu (Augsburg).
81' Rodrigo Ribeiro goes off the pitch and Michael Gregoritsch (Augsburg) comes on.
80' Rodrigo Ribeiro (Augsburg) wins the ball near the penalty spot and unleashes a header towards the roof of the net, but Kamil Grabara is alert and denies him.
79' Now Augsburg have a corner.
78' The attendance is 19631.
75' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) steps up to send the ball in.
74' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) sends the corner into the box, but Finn Dahmen intercepts it and averts the threat. Corner kick. Wolfsburg will have an opportunity.

71' 2 - 1 Goal! Mohamed Amoura shows great vision to find Kento Shiogai (Wolfsburg) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the right side of the goal. 2:1.
70' Marius Wolf (Augsburg) spurns a great opportunity from inside the 6-yard box. The ball flies narrowly wide of the left post.
68' Manuel Baum has decided to make a change. Marius Wolf (Augsburg) replaces Dimitrios Giannoulis.
68' A substitution has been made. Han-Noah Massengo goes off and Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) comes on.
68' It will be a corner kick for Augsburg.
68' Kamil Grabara blocks Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg)'s effort from the edge of the box.
66' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
65' Daniel Bauer is forced to make a change. Mattias Svanberg is unable to continue due to injury, Kevin Paredes (Wolfsburg) comes on.
65' Substitution. Lovro Majer leaves the pitch and is replaced by Kento Shiogai (Wolfsburg).
65' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
64' What was Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.

59' 1 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Superb finishing from Rodrigo Ribeiro (Augsburg). Alexis Claude-Maurice plays a fantastic through ball and finds Rodrigo Ribeiro (Augsburg), who reacts quickly to get in front of the goalkeeper and fire a close-range shot into the bottom right corner. 1:1.
59' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
58' Here comes a substitution. Fabian Rieder (Augsburg) is brought on as a substitute for Mert Komur.
58' Dimitrios Giannoulis (Augsburg) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box. The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg will have a goal kick.
55' Keven Schlotterbeck (Augsburg) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
53' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) takes the corner.
52' PENALTY APPEAL after Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
52' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
51' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) sends a long ball in, but Finn Dahmen comfortably gathers the ball.
50' Rodrigo Ribeiro (Augsburg) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort just wide of the left post.
45+1' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' Rodrigo Ribeiro (Augsburg) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
45' Rodrigo Ribeiro (Augsburg) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
41' 1 - 0 Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) meets the corner and displays his eye for goal as he coolly plants a header from close range into the left side of the goal. The score is 1:0.
41' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.

40' Denis Vavro (Wolfsburg) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the underside of the crossbar is, however, superbly saved by Finn Dahmen! The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Wolfsburg.
36' That was close. Mert Komur (Augsburg) fires a shot from the edge of the box which goes a whisker wide of the right post.
35' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) rushes a shot from long range and subsequently sends it high over the bar.
30' Augsburg take a short corner kick.
30' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
28' Christian Eriksen beats an opponent and whips a cross into the box towards Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg), who smashes a first-time shot high over the bar.
25' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
24' Augsburg get a corner.
24' Dimitrios Giannoulis (Augsburg) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. The ball goes out of play. Augsburg are awarded a corner kick.
23' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Sael Kumbedi (Wolfsburg) but poses no threat.
21' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Daniel Schlager who sees an offensive foul.
20' Keven Schlotterbeck (Augsburg) is able to continue to play.
19' The game is interrupted now, Keven Schlotterbeck (Augsburg) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
18' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
17' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
17' Keven Schlotterbeck (Augsburg) jumps above the defenders in order to convert a lofted cross with a nice header. Kamil Grabara makes a reflexive save to block his effort from hitting the net.
16' Sael Kumbedi (Wolfsburg) was too forceful with his tackle and Daniel Schlager interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Augsburg earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
12' Good work from Augsburg as they win a corner.
11' Augsburg take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

10' A loose ball is pounced on by Han-Noah Massengo (Augsburg) inside the box. He immediately fires in a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Kamil Grabara is alert and makes a comfortable save. The ball goes out of play. Augsburg are awarded a corner kick.
9' Noahkai Banks (Augsburg) commits a foul and Daniel Schlager immediately signals a free kick.
6' Rodrigo Ribeiro (Augsburg) gets on the end of a cross and heads the ball towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a fine save.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Wolfsburg will kick the game off.
Daniel Schlager will supervise the game today.
